matrikaMeaning: Matrika means the nurturing, motherly energy of healing — treating from the depth and vibration of natural sources, guided by the wisdom of homoeopathy.
heading: A Practice Built on Listening
bio1: Dr. Pujaa Scinde (BHMS) founded Matrika Homoeopathy with a simple belief: real healing begins when a doctor truly listens. Every consultation starts with a detailed case history — your physical symptoms, daily habits, emotional state, and family history — because homeopathy treats the person, not just the diagnosis.
bio2: She works with patients of all ages, from young children to seniors, treating both acute complaints and long-standing chronic conditions. Her approach blends classical homeopathic principles with an honest, modern bedside manner: clear communication, realistic expectations, and consistent follow-up.
bio3: All consultations are conducted online, so you can speak with Dr. Pujaa from wherever you are.
educationDetail: A foundation in homoeopathic medicine, with a commitment to continuous learning and thoughtful patient care.
practiceDetail: Caring, personal online consultations that focus on listening to you and helping you make informed health decisions.
areasDetail: Women's health, skin and hair concerns, respiratory and digestive complaints, emotional well-being, and health concerns across different stages of life.
